bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to data practices; prohibiting government entities from sharing personally identifiable information with federal agencies; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 13.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[13.11] DATA DISSEMINATION TO FEDERAL OFFICIALS AND AGENCIES PROHIBITED.

Subdivision 1.

Definition.

For purposes of this section, "personally identifiable information" means any government data in which an individual is or can be identified as the subject of the data.

Subd. 2.

Prohibited data sharing.

(a) Notwithstanding any law to the contrary and except as provided in paragraph (b), a government entity must not disseminate to a federal official or agency data of any classification that contains personally identifiable information unless the data is first masked or otherwise anonymized.

(b) A government entity may share personally identifiable information with federal officials or agencies only to the extent necessary to comply with a state statute or federal law or pursuant to a court order.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
